name: RSS feed → Presentations.AI presentation → email link

parameters.content:
## Turn new RSS posts into presentations

### How it works
This workflow checks an RSS feed every hour. For each new post, Presentations.AI summarizes the post's text into a presentation, and the workflow emails you a link to it. The link opens the presentation in Presentations.AI, so it needs a sign-in to your workspace. The workflow uses the `content:encodedSnippet` field, the full post text with the HTML tags removed. Feeds that only publish a short summary have no such field, so it falls back to `contentSnippet` (the short summary) and then to the title.

### Setup
1. Install the community node package `@presentations-ai/n8n-nodes-presentations-ai` (tested with version 0.3.2 and later). Follow [n8n's guide to installing verified community nodes](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/).
2. Create an API key at [api.presentations.ai](https://api.presentations.ai/#/apikeys) with the **Deck automation** preset, then create a **Presentations.AI API** credential with it and select it on the Presentations.AI node. Presentations.AI charges credits per slide.
3. Set **Feed URL** in the RSS Feed Trigger. The `https://example.com/feed.xml` value is a placeholder.
4. Create an **SMTP** credential for **Email the presentation link** and set the From and To addresses (the `example.com` addresses are placeholders).
5. Test the workflow, then publish it. The first run only picks up posts published after that.

### Customization
Change **Preservation Mode** (Enhance builds a fuller deck from the text) or add **Slide Count**, **Brand Kit** and **Target Audience**. Set **Language** to a fixed language such as Spanish to translate the deck. Send the link to Slack or Notion instead of email by swapping the last node.

### Want a public link instead?
Turn on **Create Share Link** in the Presentations.AI node and put `{{ $json.share_url }}` in the email. A share link makes the presentation public: anyone with the link and everyone in your workspace can view it.

## 1. Watch the feed
Polls every hour. In a manual test it returns the latest post.

## 2. Create the presentation
**Content** is the post's full text. **Topic or Instructions** is the post title. **Language** is `auto` so the deck follows the post's language. Each slide uses credits.

## 4. Send the link
The email contains `deck_url`, which opens the presentation after a Presentations.AI sign-in. No public link is made.

## 3. Check it's ready
If the presentation isn't finished within **Max Wait**, it goes to **Not ready in time** instead of emailing an empty link. Raise Max Wait, or check it later with **Get Status** and `request_id`.
